crowns.notes: no protected base amount; attacker takes crowns first; diamonds cannot buy crowns

combat.tie_rule: defender wins if both sides remain after 6 rounds
combat.salvage_note: 40% of destroyed ships recoverable as wrecks, 40% of dead soldiers wounded to hospital
battle_phases: sea: ships vs ships in port + sea installations (coastal gun, water blockade, watchtower, cannon tower)
landing (only with troops): soldiers+ships vs soldiers, land installations (catapult, watchtower, cannon tower), city wall; no landing while defending ships float or water blockade stands
combat.conquest_garrison: 1 soldier per building level of island, min 50; needs land victory + surviving colony ship

fortification.applies_to: defender installations + defence buildings HP only; ships/soldiers unchanged

combat.debris_field: if >=5 ships sink in front of island: 6h (extendable to 24h); later-departing foreign attack fleets turn back
combat.building_bombardment: after land victory 10% of remaining force hits buildings; building level HP = construction cost/100; max 1 lvl/building, 3/attack, 6/island/24h; main house, settlements, defensive buildings exempt
combat.fleet_boarding: needs Warship lvl 10 + soldiers; 50% of surviving harbour ships captured (most valuable first), prize crew >= troop slots (min 5); prize 25% damage

points.note: every level counts the same regardless of building

diamonds.halve_remaining_time: 1 diamond per started 30 min saved, once per order
